name: SPACE MARINES: ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH HEAVY BOLTERS
description:
Before the withering ire of an Eradicator Squad with Heavy Bolters, swarming foes and clusters of enemy infantry stand little chance. Eradicators wear the heavier Gravis pattern of Mk X power armour, allowing them to stride unharmed through waves of incoming fire before bringing their own destructive heavy weaponry to bear.

Scythe Down Swathes of the Enemy

This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Eradicators with Heavy Bolters, a powerful anti-infantry squad for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Adept at using their heavy weapons to chew through packed-in hordes of troops, clusters of xenos, and even light vehicles, they are a useful asset to any strike force. The Sergeant can be assembled with a helmet or bare head.

Contents:
– 34 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 40mm Round Hex Hole Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet

The Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet features 664 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors, as well as unit designations, numbers, honour markings, and campaign badges to decorate your miniatures.

These push-fit miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour paints
